decisions.decision: Preferred northwest SEQLD site exists as current fit-check/reference, but master infrastructure remains site-neutral, modular and redeployable.
Core relaunch/Watch Tower/R&D cluster locally; residential/transport nodes may be remote; current maglev concept is ~11 km away; long-term national/international federated deployment.
Integrate with existing universities/governance/specialist facilities rather than duplicate every institutional capability.
Public gallery/education waits until operational core is stable.
Phase-1 relocatable two-person shipping-container-style studio accommodation; reuse/move as site matures.
Limited higher-risk in-perimeter executive/operational residence may exist; founder/family/community residence remains separate from work precinct.
Use courtyard-facing local frame; wing sequence left then clockwise; number inside-to-out and then front-to-back; rotation/mirror/courtyard flip allowed; true north is separate site frame.
InterSol is relaunch/repair/integration/mission-support and Römer-technology deployment hub, not full launch-vehicle manufacturing.
Single principal anti-parallel incoming/outgoing warehouse; early operations can use partial future envelope; central internal fine/clean integration rooms.
Semi-reconfigurable clean/fine-assembly modules inside permanent warehouse shell, with sliding/opening partitions for large components.
R&D and warehouse remain separate buildings linked by controlled outdoor logistics routes.
Hybrid internal/subcontractor/co-delivery/external-lab model with deliberate staff training and knowledge transfer toward internal expertise.
Chain-hill/magnetic-assist low-energy transport remains preferred design intent/trade-study candidate, not yet fixed engineering baseline.
Phase 1 spans bench to ~1 m3 single-cell validation using common base architecture, with scale/geometry/chemistry varied by evidence.
Candidate materials include bismuth, copper, iron, silver, ceramic and carbon/graphene-related components; low-toxicity/recyclability is design intent, not blanket validated safety.
Internal 3D-printed conductive/semi-conductive casing is electroplated on both inner and outer surfaces; external casing is separate insulating polymer enclosure.
Research whether internal/external conductor geometry and local electromagnetic interactions create cancellation/losses and whether geometry/chemistry can reduce them.
Use technology-centric twins (Solar Hull, Free Flow Battery, Free Flow Capacitor); prototype/test configurations are rows/receipts, not separate master twins.

Every workbook preserves raw appendix-log/index entries including failed/null/outlier/invalid-harness results plus separate shorthand synthesis with hypothesis/null/expectation/observation/outliers/reasoning/next steps.
Continuous cross-corpus/cross-discipline analysis is default; unresolved gaps become explicit known-unknowns.

Cross-domain patterns automatically generate agent-reviewed research proposals with completed-task comparison, expected information gain and preliminary H/M/L priority; owner can override priority/depth.
Prioritise material knowledge/operational yield, uncertainty reduction, dependency unlock and safety impact ahead of tiny precision gains unless those gains are acceptance-critical.

guardrails: Partner names mentioned in planning remain proposed/earmarked until formally evidenced.
Approximate site relationships are owner-current planning inputs, not survey/geodetic authority.
Free Flow material safety/performance and electromagnetic-field geometry concepts remain R&D hypotheses until empirical validation.
Historical evidence is not silently overwritten by owner-current decisions; use supersession receipts.
